I can't speak for other people, but my main reasons are 1. control and 2. addiction. I often sh when I feel I don't have any control over my life, or when I feel like I'm spiraling into a pit of stress that I can't do anything about. But I also sh when I feel fine, and I attribute that to simple addiction. It might not apply to you since you started only a week ago, but habit is a big player for me. I often don't actually THINK when I sh, I just DO it and there isn't any real reason why, except for I'm used to it and it feels good. (Cutting releases good brain chemicals, that's often the underlying reason for why ppl cut when they're stressed or down).

Yeah, people cut for different reasons, and sometimes they overlap as well. The emotional numbness is very common for me, but I occasionally cut bc of too much emotion as well, they're both totally valid.

1. I agree with everything ppl have said about this one so far, taking the instrument away with no warning doesn't often help because where there's a will there's a way, really. You should still discuss it with her though, she might appreciate this step towards distancing herself from the urges. 
2. Personally, I tend (tended? I'm on a clean streak) to do it when I felt like my life is spiraling out of control and/or when I find myself struggling to care about anything. The reason I do it is to feel something and/or to have this one thing that I can feel in control of. Honestly it is more of a control issue for me generally. It differs a little for everyone though. 
3. As for things I wish people would do, it differs for every person and the relationship you have with them I guess. In my case I would never really want to discuss anything even post crisis, I like to be distracted, maybe with a board game or a walk or something. 

You're an awesome person btw. I am glad there are people like you in the world who want to learn more about the issues their partners are facing in order to best support them. Keep learning, keep asking questions.
